98 HTTP200 headers, approximately 47 seconds, or related character totals are observations, not a documented 100-request or character quota.
HTTP200 headers do not alone prove translation completion; article acceptance requires all original source identities mapped and zero failed/pending/code translations.
The fixture runs used original Tampermonkey with real DeepL TLS traffic in an isolated headless test browser. They are not actual user Edge or OS-foreground visual verification.
